core.subject: Domain Scorecard -- recommendation and confidence matrix across all activated C-suite domains
objects: {{DOMAIN_RECOMMENDATIONS}} -- per-domain recommendation (approve / approve with conditions / oppose / neutral) with confidence level (high / medium / low)
{{INTERNAL_CONTRADICTIONS}} -- flagged contradictions within any domain's team lead findings
notes: {{ACTIVATED_DOMAINS}} -- list of domains that participated in the analysis
{{DECISION_MODE}} -- the synthesis mode applied (Guardian / Pioneer / Architect / Analyst / Sentinel)
constraints: All text must be legible at 6.5 inch print width
No decorative elements -- every visual element conveys data

data.domain_count: {{DOMAIN_COUNT}} -- number of activated domains in the scorecard
data.consensus_level: {{CONSENSUS_LEVEL}} -- overall consensus / mild dissent / strong dissent / split decision
data.most_determinative: {{MOST_DETERMINATIVE}} -- the domain perspective weighted highest in CEO synthesis
